# Model vs market (generated by `scripts/market_benchmark.py`)

Generated 2026-11-10T05:45 UTC. Market = Polymarket, margin removed proportionally. Lower log-loss / Brier is better. See docs/experiments/EXP-004-market-benchmark.md.
